def.label: Mk1 visual sight
def.note: max_range_cells 60, classify_after_ms 3,000 and share_range_cells 30 are 16b section 9's own constants, moved to content as that table says. max_attenuation 40 is cut C's, picked off the atlas's own opacity table rather than out of the air: light woods attenuate 25 and heavy woods 60, so 40 is the line that lets a tank see through one belt of light woods and not through a canopy. sees_wrecks false is what makes doc 16 section 3.3's 'an obstacle and a contact, never a target' start as an obstacle only. THE SIGNATURE TABLE (cut S.1) scales the reach per mille by the ground the target stands on, moving against stopped: moving on a road is 1000 and hides nothing, stopped in heavy woods is 500 and is seen at half the reach, and the rows between are that one axis -- bare ground 900, grass 800, rubble 700, light woods 650, stopped. A class the table does not name is 1000/1000, so this is the list of grounds that conceal and not a list every class must appear in; open water is deliberately absent.
